Melia Antiqua, First Princess,[XENO:n ]
has returned, Your Majesty.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Raise your head.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Your Majesty.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

The Telethia rained havoc on countless veteran knights.[XENO:n ]
You triumphed where they could not.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

I find it difficult to suppress these[XENO:n ]
feelings of pride for you, my kin.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT1 ][XENO:del del=this ]

But, Your Majesty, I failed to return with[XENO:n ]
any of the subjects you entrusted to me.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
My inexperience cost them their lives.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

We will grieve for them, but it[XENO:n ]
could not have been avoided.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

It was their duty and honour[XENO:n ]
to fight beside you.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
They were all aware of your limits.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Emperor.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Keep those feelings of frustration close to you.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]It will help you to remember the debt[XENO:n ]
you owe to those that have fallen.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

Your Majesty, concerning such debts,[XENO:n ]
there were others who aided me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

The Homs and Nopon that accompanied you[XENO:n ]
to the capital?[XENO:wait wait=key ]
They have been arrested by Imperial Security.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Shulk and his companions?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yes. For reasons pertaining to the[XENO:n ]
weapon this Shulk possesses.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Shulk's weapon...[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Do you mean the Monado?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
So it is true.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

If that weapon is truly the Monado,[XENO:n ]
we shall be forced to take action.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Why?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
There is a legend, passed down through the generations.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Of a divine weapon - the Monado.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

It is said that the Giant God itself bestows[XENO:n ]
the blade upon a chosen one.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

However, if the chosen one is black of heart,[XENO:n ]
he will cause the destruction of the High Entia.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Among High Entia exist the good and bad alike.[XENO:n ]
Homs and Nopon are no different.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]If this boy is the chosen one...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]The divine seer's interrogation will[XENO:n ]
reveal where his allegiances lie.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]So you intend to keep them confined?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT5 ][XENO:del del=this ]
We must.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Father! I mean... Your Majesty![XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT13 ]I assure you Shulk is of pure heart![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]As my successor, you will play a role of great importance.[XENO:n ]
Calm your spirit and be patient.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
I...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Dear sister, I can see the Emperor's[XENO:n ]
words have confused you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Brother.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

His Majesty has spoken. He recognises you[XENO:n ]
as the crown princess.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT1 ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You are to be the next[XENO:n ]
ruler of the High Entia.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Me? And not you?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yes. The Emperor asked for my counsel,[XENO:n ]
and I told him as I tell you now.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

You will make a fine Empress. There is[XENO:n ]
no one more suited to leading our people.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You proved that when you[XENO:n ]
dispatched the Telethia.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I don't know what to...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Melia.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]But the soldiers... I am not fit to rule.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
I should visit their families and beg for pardon.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Melia, you know that this is not allowed.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I know, but it does nothing for the guilt I feel.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

It is as the Emperor said. Grieve their departing,[XENO:n ]
and engrave in your heart their great deeds.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I will.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
You are right to question these things.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]But take pride in who you are.[XENO:n ]
The Emperor has chosen wisely in you, Melia.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
I am to be crown princess.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Yes, you are.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

The Ministries of Research and Records are[XENO:n ]
united in support of His Majesty's decision.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I, Minister Rouren, have no objection[XENO:n ]
to your appointment.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
I understand.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I would never openly question[XENO:n ]
our divine emperor.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]

But the wielder of the Monado, the chosen one,[XENO:n ]
might be a useful tool.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You think so too?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yes.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

But a lowly servant of the realm such as myself[XENO:n ]
could never question His Majesty.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]However, if the divine seer were to intervene...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]The seer could free Shulk?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
They should be exchanging words as we speak.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
